title: WoltFlow Token Reviewer Privacy Policy
description: Privacy policy for the WoltFlow Token Reviewer browser extension

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.description: The WoltFlow Token Reviewer is a simple browser extension that displays your Wolt access and refresh tokens when you click on it. This privacy policy explains how the extension handles your data and clarifies that no data ever leaves your browser unless you manually copy and paste it.

tokenDisplay.title: Token Display
items: Reads your Wolt access token and refresh token from browser cookies
Displays the tokens in a simple popup interface when you click the extension
Shows copy buttons next to each token for easy clipboard copying
Only activates when you manually click the extension button

permissions.title: Browser Permissions
items: Cookies: Read cookies from Wolt domains to display your authentication tokens
Host Permissions: Access to *.wolt.com domains only to read authentication cookies

access.title: What We Access
items: Wolt refresh tokens (from browser cookies only)
Wolt access tokens (from browser cookies only)

storage.title: Data Storage
items: No Storage: Extension doesn't store any data anywhere - not locally, not remotely
Display Only: Tokens are only displayed in the popup interface while it's open
No Persistence: When you close the popup, nothing is saved or remembered

transmission.title: Data Transmission
items: NO Data Transmission: The extension never sends any data to any servers, ever
No Network Requests: Extension makes zero network calls or connections
Manual Only: Data only leaves your browser if you manually copy it to your clipboard and paste it elsewhere
Completely Local: Everything happens locally in your browser

extension.title: Extension Security
items: Minimal permissions requested (only what's necessary)
No background processing or persistent scripts
Code is minimized and focused on single purpose
No external dependencies or third-party libraries

protection.title: Data Protection
items: No data transmission means no transmission security concerns
No local storage or caching of any data
Extension operates only when you click the popup button
No automatic, background, or scheduled operations

control.title: Extension Control
items: Uninstall the extension anytime from browser settings
Extension only runs when you click it
No automatic or scheduled operations
Full control over when tokens are displayed

data.title: Data Control
items: Tokens displayed are your existing Wolt authentication cookies
You control if/when/where you use the copied token information

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.intro: The extension only accesses browser cookies - it does not communicate with any external services or servers:

cookieAccess.title: Cookie Access Only
items: *.wolt.com cookies: Extension reads your existing authentication cookies from Wolt domains
No API calls: Extension never communicates with Wolt servers or any other servers
No WoltFlow communication: Extension does not send any data to WoltFlow servers
Extension only reads existing authentication data locally

updates.title: Policy Updates
updates.description: This privacy policy may be updated to reflect changes in the extension's functionality or legal requirements. Users will be notified of material changes through the extension update process or via the main WoltFlow service.

effective.title: Effective Date
effective.p1: This Extension Privacy Policy is effective as of {{date}}.
effective.p2: By installing and using the WoltFlow Token Reviewer extension, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.
